requirements.title: Settings from flag, environment and configuration file
requirements.rationale: A person at a terminal logs in once and an agent gets its settings in its environment; both must reach the same hub with the same command line (PLAT-FR-090).

criteria.condition: a command whose auth is user or admin runs
criteria.action: take the hub URL from the first non-empty value of the flag --endpoint-url, the variable PARLEY_ENDPOINT_URL and the file key endpoint_url, and the credential from the first non-empty value of the flag --api-key, the variable PARLEY_API_KEY and the file key api_key
criteria.contract: the command's request arrives at the chosen hub URL and carries the header Authorization: Bearer <the chosen credential>; an empty flag value or an empty variable is passed over for the next source

setup: three httptest servers A, B and C each answer GET /api/v1/things/x with 200 {} and record their requests
a probe command 'probe get <name>' declared by the test through the declaration helper of internal/cli/command.go with method GET, path /things/:name and auth user
PARLEY_CONFIG_DIR points at a directory under t.TempDir(); PARLEY_ENDPOINT_URL and PARLEY_API_KEY are unset unless the case sets them
check.pseudocode: in internal/cli/config_test.go, a table over (flag url, env url, file url, flag key, env key, file key) -> (expected hub, expected key): {(A,B,C,k1,k2,k3)->(A,k1); (absent,B,C,absent,k2,k3)->(B,k2); (absent,unset,C,absent,unset,k3)->(C,k3); ('',B,C,'',k2,k3)->(B,k2); (absent,'',C,absent,'',k3)->(C,k3); (A,unset,C,absent,unset,k3)->(A,k3)}: code = run(['probe','get','x'] + flags); assert code == 0; assert only the expected hub recorded a request; assert its Authorization header == 'Bearer ' + expected key

criteria.condition: a command whose auth is user or admin runs and the hub URL, the credential or both have no non-empty value in flag, variable and configuration file
criteria.action: fail before any request with a client error whose message names, for each missing setting, its flag, its variable and the path of the configuration file
criteria.contract: exit status 2; stdout is empty; stderr is one JSON document {error: {code: 0, message, error_type: "client_error"}}; when the hub URL is missing the message contains --endpoint-url, PARLEY_ENDPOINT_URL and the configuration file's path; when the credential is missing it contains --api-key, PARLEY_API_KEY and the configuration file's path; no request is sent

setup: an httptest server stands in for the hub and records every request's method, raw path and headers
a probe command 'probe get <name>' declared by the test through the declaration helper of internal/cli/command.go with method GET, path /things/:name and auth user
PARLEY_CONFIG_DIR points at a directory under t.TempDir(); PARLEY_ENDPOINT_URL and PARLEY_API_KEY are unset unless the case sets them
check.pseudocode: in internal/cli/config_test.go, a table over what is missing {hub URL only, credential only, both; each with the file absent and with a file that holds only user_id}: code = run(['probe','get','x'] + flags); assert code == 2; assert stdout == ''; e = json(stderr).error; assert e.code == 0 and e.error_type == 'client_error'; assert e.message contains the flag, the variable and the path <config dir>/config.toml of each missing setting and not the flag of a setting that was given; assert hub requests == 0

criteria.condition: the hub URL a command resolved is not an absolute URL with scheme http or https and a host
criteria.action: fail before any request with a client error whose message names the value
criteria.contract: exit status 2; stdout is empty; stderr is one JSON document with error.code 0 and error.error_type "client_error", and error.message contains the rejected value; no request is sent

setup: a probe command 'probe get <name>' declared by the test through the declaration helper of internal/cli/command.go with method GET, path /things/:name and auth user
PARLEY_CONFIG_DIR points at a directory under t.TempDir(); PARLEY_ENDPOINT_URL and PARLEY_API_KEY are unset unless the case sets them
check.pseudocode: in internal/cli/config_test.go, a table over hub URLs {'localhost:8080', 'ftp://host', 'http://', '/api', 'host'} given by --endpoint-url with --api-key k: code = run(['probe','get','x', ...]); assert code == 2; assert stdout == ''; assert json(stderr).error.error_type == 'client_error'; assert json(stderr).error.message contains the value

criteria.condition: flags and environment variables give every setting the command needs
criteria.action: run the command without reading the configuration file
criteria.contract: the command sends its request and exits 0 although the configuration file holds text that is not valid TOML

criteria.condition: a developer runs parley version, neither --endpoint-url nor PARLEY_ENDPOINT_URL gives a non-empty value, and the configuration file holds endpoint_url
criteria.action: send GET <endpoint_url without trailing slash>/version without an Authorization header and print the client's build and the hub's build
criteria.contract: exit status 0; stdout is one JSON document {cli: {version, commit}, server: {version, commit, build_time, go_version}} whose server member holds what the hub answered; the hub records one request to /version with no Authorization header, although the file also holds api_key

criteria.condition: a developer runs parley version, neither --endpoint-url nor PARLEY_ENDPOINT_URL gives a non-empty value, and the configuration file exists and cannot be parsed
criteria.action: write one warning line that names the file to stderr, print the client's build without a server member and exit with success
criteria.contract: exit status 0; stdout is the JSON document {cli: {version, commit}} with no server member; stderr holds exactly one line, it begins with "warning: " and contains the file's path

setup: PARLEY_CONFIG_DIR points at a directory under t.TempDir(); PARLEY_ENDPOINT_URL and PARLEY_API_KEY are unset unless the case sets them
check.pseudocode: in internal/cli/version_test.go: write 'not = [toml' to <config dir>/config.toml; code = cli.Run(ctx, ['version'], stdout, stderr); assert code == 0; assert keys(json(stdout)) == {cli}; lines = nonEmptyLines(stderr); assert len(lines) == 1 and lines[0] starts with 'warning: ' and contains <config dir>/config.toml

criteria.action: accept the global flags --endpoint-url <url>, --api-key <credential> and --json on every command, before or after the command's own words, and give --json no effect when neither help nor --help is asked for
criteria.contract: a command line with a global flag in any position runs as the same command; the same command with and without --json sends the same request and prints the same stdout

a probe command 'probe get <name>' declared by the test through the declaration helper of internal/cli/command.go with method GET, path /things/:name and auth user

check.pseudocode: in internal/cli/root_test.go, a table over argument orders {['--endpoint-url',H,'--api-key','k','probe','get','x'], ['probe','--api-key','k','get','x','--endpoint-url',H], ['probe','get','x','--endpoint-url='+H,'--api-key=k'], the first with '--json' added}: code = run(args); assert code == 0; assert hub recorded GET /api/v1/things/x with Authorization 'Bearer k'; assert stdout equals the stdout of the first case

requirements.title: The client configuration file
requirements.rationale: The file is what parley login leaves behind; it holds a credential, so where it lives, who creates it and how it is replaced are fixed (docs/prd/03_platform.md §3.3.7).

criteria.action: locate the configuration file at $PARLEY_CONFIG_DIR/config.toml when PARLEY_CONFIG_DIR is set and non-empty, and otherwise at .parley/config.toml under the user's home directory
criteria.contract: the path function of internal/cli/config.go returns <PARLEY_CONFIG_DIR>/config.toml or <home>/.parley/config.toml

check.pseudocode: in internal/cli/config_test.go, a table over (PARLEY_CONFIG_DIR, HOME) -> path: {('/tmp/a', '/home/u') -> '/tmp/a/config.toml'; (unset, '/home/u') -> '/home/u/.parley/config.toml'; ('', '/home/u') -> '/home/u/.parley/config.toml'}: set both with t.Setenv; assert configPath() == path; and with a file holding endpoint_url and api_key at <HOME>/.parley/config.toml and PARLEY_CONFIG_DIR unset, run(['probe','get','x']) reaches the hub the file names

criteria.condition: the configuration file does not exist, or PARLEY_CONFIG_DIR is unset or empty and the home directory cannot be determined
criteria.action: resolve the settings from flags and environment variables alone and create neither the directory nor the file
criteria.contract: a command given both settings by variables exits 0; a command missing a setting exits 2 with error_type client_error; after either, the configuration directory does not exist

check.pseudocode: in internal/cli/config_test.go, a table over {PARLEY_CONFIG_DIR = <tmp>/missing; PARLEY_CONFIG_DIR unset and HOME = <tmp>/nohome; PARLEY_CONFIG_DIR unset and HOME unset}: with both variables set, code = run(['probe','get','x']); assert code == 0; with PARLEY_API_KEY unset, assert code == 2 and json(stderr).error.error_type == 'client_error'; assert no directory <tmp>/missing and no directory <tmp>/nohome/.parley exists afterwards

criteria.condition: a command needs a setting from the configuration file and the file exists and cannot be read, is not valid TOML, or holds endpoint_url, api_key or user_id with a value that is not a string
criteria.action: fail before any request with a client error that names the file's path
criteria.contract: exit status 2; stdout is empty; stderr is one JSON document with error.code 0 and error.error_type "client_error", and error.message contains the file's path; no request is sent

PARLEY_CONFIG_DIR points at a directory under t.TempDir(); PARLEY_ENDPOINT_URL and PARLEY_API_KEY are unset unless the case sets them
check.pseudocode: in internal/cli/config_test.go, a table over file states {content 'not = [toml'; content 'endpoint_url = 5'; content 'api_key = ["a"]'; valid content with mode 0000 (skipped when the test runs as root); a directory named config.toml}: PARLEY_ENDPOINT_URL = hub, PARLEY_API_KEY unset; code = run(['probe','get','x']); assert code == 2; assert stdout == ''; e = json(stderr).error; assert e.code == 0 and e.error_type == 'client_error' and e.message contains <config dir>/config.toml; assert hub requests == 0

criteria.condition: parley login saves settings and the configuration directory or the file does not exist yet
criteria.action: create the directory with mode 0700 when it is missing and write the file with mode 0600, holding the keys endpoint_url, api_key and user_id with the saved values
criteria.contract: the save function of internal/cli/config.go returns no error; the directory's permission bits are 0700; the file's permission bits are 0600; the file parses as TOML with exactly the three string keys; a command run afterwards without flags or variables uses the saved hub URL and credential

setup: an httptest server stands in for the hub and records every request's method, raw path and headers
a probe command 'probe get <name>' declared by the test through the declaration helper of internal/cli/command.go with method GET, path /things/:name and auth user
the process umask is 022
check.pseudocode: in internal/cli/config_test.go: PARLEY_CONFIG_DIR = <tmp>/new/dir (not existing); err = save({endpoint_url: hub, api_key: 'k', user_id: 'u1'}); assert err == nil; assert stat(<tmp>/new/dir).mode.perm == 0700; assert stat(file).mode.perm == 0600; assert toml(file) == {endpoint_url: hub, api_key: 'k', user_id: 'u1'}; code = run(['probe','get','x']); assert code == 0 and hub saw Authorization 'Bearer k'

criteria.condition: parley login saves settings and the configuration file already exists
criteria.action: replace the file atomically with a file of mode 0600 that holds the saved values for endpoint_url, api_key and user_id and every other key of the old file with its value
criteria.contract: the save function returns no error; the file's permission bits are 0600 whatever they were before; keys the CLI does not know, tables included, read back with their old values; the directory holds config.toml and no other entry; the file was replaced by a rename, so its inode differs from the old file's

setup: PARLEY_CONFIG_DIR points at a directory under t.TempDir(); PARLEY_ENDPOINT_URL and PARLEY_API_KEY are unset unless the case sets them
check.pseudocode: in internal/cli/config_test.go: write a file with mode 0644 holding endpoint_url = 'http://old', api_key = 'old', color = 'blue', retries = 3 and a table [profile] with name = 'x'; inodeBefore = stat(file).inode; err = save({endpoint_url: 'http://new', api_key: 'new', user_id: 'u2'}); assert err == nil; got = toml(file); assert got.endpoint_url == 'http://new' and got.api_key == 'new' and got.user_id == 'u2'; assert got.color == 'blue' and got.retries == 3 and got.profile.name == 'x'; assert stat(file).mode.perm == 0600; assert stat(file).inode != inodeBefore; assert readdir(dir) == ['config.toml']

criteria.condition: a save of the configuration file cannot write the new file, cannot replace the old one, or finds an existing file it cannot parse
criteria.action: return an error that names the file's path, leave the previous file byte for byte as it was and remove any temporary file it created
criteria.contract: the save function returns a client error whose message contains the file's path (a command that surfaces it exits 2 with error_type client_error); the previous file's bytes and mode are unchanged; the directory holds no entry other than the ones it held before

setup: PARLEY_CONFIG_DIR points at a directory under t.TempDir(); PARLEY_ENDPOINT_URL and PARLEY_API_KEY are unset unless the case sets them
check.pseudocode: in internal/cli/config_test.go, a table over {the directory has mode 0500 and holds a valid file (skipped as root); config.toml is a non-empty directory; the existing file holds 'not = [toml'; PARLEY_CONFIG_DIR unset and HOME unset}: before = (bytes, mode, readdir); err = save(settings); assert err != nil and err is a client error; where a path exists assert message contains it; assert (bytes, mode, readdir) == before

requirements.title: One HTTP client for every command
requirements.rationale: Every command reaches the hub the same way, so a script that works for one command works for all (PLAT-FR-091).

criteria.condition: a command sends a request for a path of the REST API
criteria.action: send it with the command's method to <hub URL without its trailing slashes>/api/v1<path> with the header Authorization: Bearer <credential>, with a JSON body and Content-Type: application/json when the command has a body, and with no body and no Content-Type header when it has none
criteria.contract: the hub receives the method, the path /api/v1<path> (after any path the hub URL itself carries), the query string the command set, the Authorization header and, for a body, bytes that parse as the JSON document the command passed

setup: an httptest server stands in for the hub and records every request's method, raw path and headers at URL H, on any path
check.pseudocode: in internal/cli/client_test.go, a table over (hub URL, method, path, query, body) {(H, GET, '/things/x', none, none); (H + '/', GET, '/things/x', 'limit=5', none); (H + '//', DELETE, '/things/x', none, none); (H + '/prefix', GET, '/things/x', none, none); (H, POST, '/things', none, {name: 'x', n: 1}); (H, PATCH, '/things/x', none, {})}: send through the client; assert recorded method, path == pathOf(hub URL) + '/api/v1' + path, query, Authorization == 'Bearer k'; with a body assert Content-Type == 'application/json' and json(recorded body) == body; without one assert no Content-Type header and content length 0

criteria.action: for any path segment that comes from a command-line argument or flag value, percent-encode it as one segment, so that a / inside it is sent as %2F
criteria.contract: the raw request path the hub receives has exactly the segments the route's pattern has; the segment holds no /, ?, # or space; percent-decoding it gives the argument back unchanged

setup: an httptest server stands in for the hub and records every request's method, raw path and headers

check.pseudocode: in internal/cli/client_test.go: the domain is strings of 1 to 64 characters drawn from letters, digits, '/', '?', '#', '%', ' ', '+', '.', '..', '&', '=' and non-ASCII letters, plus the fixed cases {'a/b', 'feature/x y', '100%', '..', 'a?b#c', 'ü/ö'}: for each s, run(['probe','get', s]); raw = recorded raw path; assert raw starts with '/api/v1/things/'; seg = raw after that prefix; assert seg contains none of '/', '?', '#', ' '; assert url.PathUnescape(seg) == s; assert the recorded query is empty

criteria.condition: no complete response arrives within the request timeout, which is 30 seconds unless the command states another
criteria.action: abandon the request and fail with a client error
criteria.contract: exit status 2; stdout is empty; stderr is one JSON document with error.code 0 and error.error_type "client_error"; the command returns no later than 1 second after the timeout; the hub recorded exactly one request

setup: a probe command 'probe get <name>' declared by the test through the declaration helper of internal/cli/command.go with method GET, path /things/:name and auth user
PARLEY_CONFIG_DIR points at a directory under t.TempDir(); PARLEY_ENDPOINT_URL and PARLEY_API_KEY are unset unless the case sets them

check.pseudocode: in internal/cli/client_test.go: assert the client's default request timeout == 30 s; a table over {the default shortened by the test to 100 ms against a hub that sleeps 2 s before answering; a probe command that states a timeout of 300 ms against a hub that sleeps 200 ms (succeeds, code 0); the same command against a hub that sleeps 2 s; a hub that sends headers and half a body and then stalls}: start = now; code = run(...); for the failing cases assert code == 2, stdout == '', json(stderr).error.error_type == 'client_error', now - start < timeout + 1 s, hub requests == 1

criteria.condition: the connection to the hub cannot be made: the connection is refused, the host name does not resolve, or the TLS handshake fails
criteria.action: fail with a client error whose message names the hub URL
criteria.contract: exit status 2; stdout is empty; stderr is one JSON document with error.code 0 and error.error_type "client_error", and error.message contains the hub URL's host

setup: a probe command 'probe get <name>' declared by the test through the declaration helper of internal/cli/command.go with method GET, path /things/:name and auth user

criteria.condition: the hub's response cannot be decoded: a 2xx status with a non-empty body that is not JSON, or a status of 400 or above whose body is not a JSON object with an error member that holds error_type
criteria.action: fail with a client error whose message names the HTTP status
criteria.contract: exit status 2; stdout is empty; stderr is one JSON document with error.code 0 and error.error_type "client_error", and error.message contains the status number

criteria.action: for any command, send each of its requests exactly once and never repeat a request because of its outcome, a 429 answer included
criteria.contract: after a command that failed with HTTP 429, 500, 502 or 503, a timeout or a broken connection, the hub has recorded exactly one request; for 429 with the error envelope, stderr holds that envelope with error_type "rate_limited" and the exit status is 1

PARLEY_CONFIG_DIR points at a directory under t.TempDir(); PARLEY_ENDPOINT_URL and PARLEY_API_KEY are unset unless the case sets them
check.pseudocode: in internal/cli/client_test.go, a table over answers {429 envelope rate_limited with Retry-After: 1; 500 envelope internal; 502 envelope upstream_error; 503 envelope unavailable; a connection the hub closes without answering}: code = run(['probe','get','x']); wait 1.5 s in the 429 case; assert hub requests == 1; for 429 assert code == 1 and json(stderr).error.error_type == 'rate_limited'

requirements.title: Result on stdout, everything else on stderr
requirements.rationale: A caller pipes stdout into a JSON parser and reads the error type from stderr; neither may ever hold anything else (PLAT-FR-092).

criteria.condition: the hub answers a command's request with a 2xx status and a JSON body
criteria.action: print the body on stdout as one JSON document indented by 2 spaces and followed by one newline, keeping the order of members and the text of numbers as received
criteria.contract: exit status 0; stdout equals the body re-indented with 2 spaces plus "\n" and parses as one JSON document equal to the body; stderr is empty

PARLEY_CONFIG_DIR points at a directory under t.TempDir(); PARLEY_ENDPOINT_URL and PARLEY_API_KEY are unset unless the case sets them
check.pseudocode: in internal/cli/output_test.go, a table over (status, body) {(200, '{"b":1,"a":{"z":[1,2],"y":null}}'); (201, '{"id":"x","n":1.50,"big":12345678901234567890}'); (200, '{"items":[],"next_cursor":null}'); (200, '[]'); (202, a body already indented with tabs)}: code = run(['probe','get','x']); assert code == 0; assert stdout == indent(compact(body), '  ') + '\n'; assert member order and number text in stdout equal the body's; assert stderr == ''

criteria.condition: the hub answers a command's request with a 2xx status and no body, as a route that answers 204 does
criteria.action: print {} on stdout, or the confirmation document where the command states one, in the same form as any result
criteria.contract: exit status 0; stdout is "{}\n" for a command without a confirmation document, and the confirmation document indented by 2 spaces plus a newline for a command with one (for example {"status": "deleted", "slug": "<slug>"} built from the command's argument); stderr is empty

criteria.condition: the hub answers a command's request with a status of 400 or above and the error envelope
criteria.action: print the envelope on stderr as received, with error_type and every extra member, print nothing on stdout and end with the exit status for a hub error
criteria.contract: exit status 1; stdout is empty; stderr is one JSON document indented by 2 spaces and followed by a newline that equals the hub's body member for member: error.code is the HTTP status, error.error_type and error.message are the hub's, and members such as error.details or error.oldest_seq are present with their values

criteria.action: for any error it raises itself, print on stderr the error envelope with code 0, a message and one of the types usage_error, client_error, wait_failed, wait_timeout and condition_not_met
criteria.contract: stderr ends with one JSON document indented by 2 spaces and followed by a newline, {"error": {"code": 0, "message": <non-empty string>, "error_type": <the type>}}, with exactly those three members inside error

check.pseudocode: in internal/cli/errors_test.go, a table over the five CLI error kinds built with the constructors of internal/cli/errors.go and one error of no named kind: write it with the error printer to a buffer; doc = json(buffer); assert keys(doc) == {error}; assert keys(doc.error) == {code, message, error_type}; assert doc.error.code == 0; assert doc.error.message != ''; assert doc.error.error_type == the kind's type ('client_error' for the error of no named kind); assert buffer == indent(doc, '  ') + '\n'

criteria.condition: a command declares that its result carries a secret that is shown once (a token or key value)
criteria.action: print the result on stdout unchanged and warn on stderr that the value will not be shown again
criteria.contract: exit status 0; stdout is the hub's document with the secret member as received; stderr holds the line "warning: this value is shown once and will not be shown again"; when the hub answers an error no such line is written

requirements.title: Help in text and as JSON
requirements.rationale: A person reads help as text; an agent discovers commands, their routes and their flags from one machine-readable description (PLAT-FR-095, §3.6).

criteria.condition: parley is run with no arguments, or with the words of a command group and no subcommand
criteria.action: print the help of the root or of the group on stdout, listing each of its subcommands with its description, without resolving settings, reading the configuration file or sending a request
criteria.contract: exit status 0; stdout holds the help text and names every direct subcommand of the root or group; stderr is empty; no request is sent

criteria.condition: parley help is run with the words of a command, or a command is run with --help
criteria.action: print that command's help as text on stdout, the same text for both forms, naming its arguments, its own flags with their defaults and the global flags, without resolving settings or sending a request
criteria.contract: exit status 0; the stdout of parley help <words> equals the stdout of parley <words> --help; it contains the command's description, each argument name and each flag name with its dashes; stderr is empty; no request is sent

execution_paths.title: A developer's command finds the hub through the configuration file

steps.action: has a configuration file with endpoint_url and api_key, as parley login leaves it, and runs parley version with no flag and no variable
finds no hub URL in --endpoint-url or PARLEY_ENDPOINT_URL, reads endpoint_url from $PARLEY_CONFIG_DIR/config.toml and sends GET /version to it without a credential
answers 200 with its version, commit, build time and Go version
prints one JSON document with the cli and server builds on stdout, writes nothing to stderr and exits 0

real_components: internal/cli with its settings resolution, its configuration file reader and its real HTTP client
the configuration file on disk, written by the save function of internal/cli/config.go
the hub's HTTP handler of internal/server with the conventions of package 02, on a real TCP listener
setup: the hub's handler serves on 127.0.0.1:0
PARLEY_CONFIG_DIR is a new temporary directory; PARLEY_ENDPOINT_URL and PARLEY_API_KEY are unset
the save function wrote endpoint_url = the hub's URL with a trailing slash, api_key = a well-formed API key the hub does not know, and user_id
end_state: parley version exited 0 and its stdout holds a server member equal to the body GET /version returns
the configuration file still has mode 0600 and the same bytes as before the command ran
smoke.pseudocode: in test/e2e/cli_test.go: before = read(file); want = json(get(hub + '/version').body); code = cli.Run(ctx, ['version'], stdout, stderr); assert code == 0; assert json(stdout).server == want; assert stderr == ''; assert read(file) == before and stat(file).mode.perm == 0600

execution_paths.title: The hub refuses a command and its error envelope reaches stderr

steps.action: runs parley login --api-key with a well-formed API key the hub does not know and --endpoint-url with the hub's URL
sends its request to <hub URL>/api/v1/user with Authorization: Bearer <the key> through the shared client, once
refuses the request with an HTTP status of 400 or above and the error envelope, error_type unauthenticated (or not_found while the route is not registered)
prints the envelope on stderr as received, prints nothing on stdout, saves no configuration file and exits 1

real_components: internal/cli: the login command of package 04 on the shared HTTP client and error output
the hub's HTTP handler of internal/server with the conventions of package 02 and the authentication of package 04, on a real TCP listener
setup: the hub's handler serves on 127.0.0.1:0 and counts requests by path through a wrapping handler
PARLEY_CONFIG_DIR is a new temporary directory that does not exist yet; PARLEY_ENDPOINT_URL and PARLEY_API_KEY are unset
end_state: the command exited 1 with empty stdout
stderr parses as one error envelope whose code equals the HTTP status the hub answered and whose error_type is unauthenticated or not_found
the hub received exactly one request under /api/v1 and it carried Authorization: Bearer <the key>
the configuration directory was not created
smoke.pseudocode: in test/e2e/cli_test.go: key = 'parley_' + 8 alphanumerics + '_' + 32 alphanumerics; code = cli.Run(ctx, ['login', '--api-key', key, '--endpoint-url', hub], stdout, stderr); assert code == 1; assert stdout == ''; e = json(stderr).error; assert e.code == recorded status and e.code >= 400; assert e.error_type in {'unauthenticated', 'not_found'}; assert recorded requests under /api/v1 == 1 and its Authorization == 'Bearer ' + key; assert not exists(PARLEY_CONFIG_DIR)
